sanity_note: Sanity range, not a price claim. Flags only, never blocks.
notes: Shop prices are often quoted cash and by phone or WhatsApp, so the user's own typed quotes are the primary data.
Online asking prices are a different market from in-person shop quotes. Keep them in their own level (online_domestic).
Load shedding and exchange-rate moves can shift prices quickly; rely on dated entries, not memory.
